name: Template-Based Volume Viewing
definition: A volume rendering technique that exploits coherence between rays in parallel projection by precomputing a single ray template (sequence of voxel increments) and reusing it for all rays, avoiding per-ray line algorithm activation.
summary: Template-Based Volume Viewing is a parallel projection technique that precomputes a single voxel increment sequence to reuse for all rays, eliminating per-ray traversal overhead and ensuring uniform discretization error.
